mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with a positive month-over-month change in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an inflationary monetary tightening cycle, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and rising FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of instances (i.e., returns are positive in more than 60% of such months).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery (HOUST above 1300 thousand units), a positive month-over-month change in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In months where HOUST exceeds 1300, RSAFS growth is positive but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening economic activity, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with a positive month-over-month change in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a synchronized economic expansion that typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and rising INDPRO fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of instances (i.e., returns are negative in more than 60% of such months).

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2.0% annualized), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an aggressive monetary tightening that typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In months with CPIAUCSL below 2.0%, a rising FEDFUNDS leads to positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
